topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The rain's a steady drum on the city tonight, a beat that's kept me awake counting the coins in my pocket. News of a teacher getting a surprise package, something nice from a kid they once taught, it's got me thinking. People get sentimental, hand over tokens of their past, trying to hold onto bits of better times. I could use a piece of the past right about now, something solid to hold on to. But sentiment, it don't pay the bills. Hell, it barely keeps the cold out. I push the thought away, light another smoke, and watch the rain. Maybe there's a case in that story, a need, a reason to dig. For now, it's just an old teacher and a gift, but every story's got a turn. I just gotta find it.
